info.title: TechBridge Phase 7 Mentorship API
info.description: Backend only. All routes require a normal JWT and enforce current account status/email gates. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Timestamp format is strict canonical UTC with milliseconds. No external calendar, email delivery, video links or frontend is introduced.

get.description: Provider only. Draft/profile and current identity eligibility; acceptingRequests also checks the opt-in identity binding and global/community contact consent. Pair-specific blocks are evaluated for each student. Internal identityKey never leaves the service.

put.description: Provider only. Full replacement with expected revision. Enable requires current visible verified faculty/alumni identity or independently approved individual provider. Concrete UTC availability windows may be ongoing but must end in the future within 90 days, last 15–480 minutes and not overlap. Confirmed future/ongoing appointments must remain covered even when disabling new requests. A new identity requires renewed opt-in.

get.description: Student only. Current identity, opt-in binding, visibility, contact consent and both block lists are filtered before pagination. Names for faculty/alumni come from the verified directory. Search is literal, case-insensitive. No email, evidence or claim details are exposed.
Student only. Free UTC intervals, with confirmed appointments subtracted. No booking IDs, student IDs or private topics. Advisory availability is rechecked transactionally at acceptance.

post.description: Student only. One active request per mentor/student; at most ten new requests per rolling 24 hours. An outbox notice for the mentor and private requested event commit in the same transaction.

get.description: Student/provider only. Only participant sessions; administrators have no private session access. Stable createdAt/ID descending history. Unknown filters are rejected.
Participant only; cross-user access is 404. No populated account/contact/evidence details.
Participant only. Append-only revision history includes private reasons, original appointments and proposed times. Administrators cannot read it.

post.description: Owning mentor only, pending to approved. Rechecks current identity, opt-in and contact consent.
Owning mentor only, pending to rejected; reason required.

Either participant, pending/approved/scheduled to cancelled; reason required. Retains appointment history and releases calendar capacity. Allowed after the other participant withdraws consent or is suspended.
Owning mentor only, scheduled to completed after its end. Never automatically marks attendance.

Either participant after mentor approval. UTC time must be future, within 90 days, on quarter-hour boundaries, 15–120 minutes, inside one mentor window and free on both calendars. At most twenty proposals per actor/rolling day. Does not reserve the proposed time; a reschedule keeps the current appointment.

Only the other participant may accept. Expected revision, both active accounts, verified identity, opt-in binding, contact settings, mentor availability and both calendars are rechecked under shared user locks in a replica-set transaction. Concurrent overlapping acceptance has one winner; old appointment is preserved on conflict.
Only the other participant may decline; reason required. Clears proposal and preserves any confirmed appointment.

get.description: Administrator only. Individual-provider accounts with current evidence reference, mentor draft and explicit approval state; never private sessions.

put.description: Independent administrator only. Approve requires identityConfirmed and expertiseConfirmed true, currently verified individual provider, matching current documentId and that admin's recorded review of the document. Revocation requires current approved revision/document, disables old opt-in, records audit history and queues a canonical notice. No organizations or seeded directory contacts are auto-approved.

get.description: Administrator only. Append-only approval/revocation audit records, preserving evidence ID, approval revision, actor and private decision reason.

Error403.description: Role, participant or contact permission denied

Error404.description: No visible mentor or owned session

Error409.description: Stale revision, unavailable identity/time or calendar conflict

Error503.description: Storage unavailable; no partial domain change
